content: Pa' ewi'ƚ jukhew ƚii Cornelio.
Na'l pa'aj pa' ewi'ƚ jukhew i'ni' pa' Cesarea, ƚii Cornelio, centurionipji' ek
pekhewe' oq'opheƚinetsilets ƚiyinyejei “el Italiano.”

Pakha'an qa week iye pekhewe' yatsat'etsij qi in yijayanija qa nijiweyiju'ƚha iye pa' Intata, t'ifti'ts'ets pekhewe' if'iljetsits pe' judiol qa tisji'jij pa'qu' hami'im. Iyinji'jii pa' Dios week neƚuts.
Ewi'ƚ pa'aj pa' neƚuji' jelji' junu' las tres qa i'nji'kii pa'aj ƚotoi itometsaaxijha pa' ewi'ƚ ƚaqa ángel pa' Dios in uyetsji' pakha' i'ni', qa yit'ijets pa'aj: —Cornelio.—

Pa' Cornelio qa ts'in in yeeƚju' pa'aj qa qi iye in neq'ijiwe'yij, qa yit'ij pa'aj: —¿Ƚekpa' ƚisu'un, Yatsat'axyij?— Pa' ángel qa yit'ijets pa'aj: —Na' Dios t'eku'miju'ƚ kekhewe' iyinheyejei qa yi'sinhetij iye in ƚetis nekhewe' if'iljetsits.
Ukinii pe'qu' jukhewe' na' witset Jope, qa' nenka'x ha' ewi'ƚ jukhew ƚii Simón qa ƚii iye Pedro.
Hane'ej i'nijup hakhap iye Simón iye inqa'met ƚ'ajits naqsi'jju', ke' ƚetsi' metetsju' ha' qi iweli'.—

Ma' qa in hats ikik'ui iye pakha' tafaakate'yi'ƚ ángel, pa' Cornelio qa taya'yii pe' wetsjuk pekhewe' ƚeqejkunenhei qa pa' ewi'ƚ oq'opheƚinetsi'l yijayaanija iye pa' Dios i'nji'teje'm pekhewe' les in t'ithayi'yi' pe' ƚetsi'ii.
Qa in hats week nifelimik'i pa'aj, ma' qa yukinii pa' witset Jope.

Qa pakhap neƚukii, pekhewe'en in mexe nekik'i pa'aj pa' wit'ikheyi'j qa hats k'esitsiyu'uiha pa'aj pa' witset Jope, ha' Pedro qa iketspha'm pa'aj pakha' ts'eewe'epji' pe' wititsi' qu' niyin hats natsa'theniyu'ju'ha pa'aj junu'.
Hats iyipkun pa'aj, qa in mexe wanaqsiijkii mente' yijat'ax pa'aj pa' ƚaq, qa namets pa'aj pakha' i'nji'kii ƚotoi hik ƚunye'j qu' nitsowoƚ'axƚe.
Qa yi'wen pa'aj na' wa's in qhofij qa pa' ewi'ƚ hik ƚunye'j na'aj qi manta qa te'nilitju' pa'aj, neketsju' ha'ne sehe' wo'nophe'ƚ pe' ikwetju'ƚ (4) ƚekfii,
qa i'nji'ju' pa' ƚatawe'j pe' ƚunyejeiƚe wetju'ƚ inqa'metets ne'ej ikwetju'ƚ (4) ƚef'iyei, qa q'oiq'oyits qa q'oiq'oq'oyits iye qa junatai iye.
Ma' qa yepi'ye' pa' wit'ax in yit'ij pa'aj: —Eniipha'm Pedro qa' anlanju' enewe'en qu' ƚuj.—
Qa yeku'ƚ pa'aj ha' Pedro: —Hasu'uj Yatsat'axyij. Nite' hayiits qetuj ekewe'ej'in qe uƚ'ets qa nite' ƚenexkelij iye.—
Qa ewi'ƚij iye, ma' qa hats wetsjuk'ij pa' wit'ax in yit'ij iye: —Pakha' qu' hats nenli'jju' na' Dios, hasu'uj it'ijets qu' uƚ'axe'.—
Qa ewi'ƚij iye pa'aj wetshetk'ewi'ƚij pa'aj in yi'wen, ma' qa pa' qi manta qa aje'eƚ wetpiletetspha'm iye na' wa's.

Ha' Pedro qi in yijamtitaxijupkii pa'n qu' naakjiha pe' yi'wen pa'aj, ma' qa hik pakha'aj qa namets pe' jukhew nukin pa' Cornelio, in hats inaqfaakaniikii pa'aj pe' ƚetsi' pa' Simón ma' qa hats namets pa'aj pa' ƚeqeji'.
Qa taya'yiiji'kii pa'aj, inaqfaakanij qu' hik pekhe'ye' pe' i'wifi pa' Simón qa ƚii iye Pedro.
Ma' qa ha' Pedro in mexente' yilitaxij in yijamtitaxijupkii pekhewe' yi'wen, qa pa' Espíritu Santo qa yit'ijets pa'aj: —Jeƚ qeku'niiju', wetshetk'ewi'ƚ ne' jukhew wo'eikii.
Eniipha'm, qa' ma'aiju', hasu'uj ef'ululi'ijkii qu' ijayan, qe yakha' he'nukinƚe ei.—
Ha' Pedro qa iketsju' pa'aj pakha' i'ni' pe' jukhew, qa yit'ij pa'aj: —Yakha' pakha' ƚowo'oƚiikii, ¿ƚek pakha' ta'ƚijupi' qa ƚanami'ƚ metkii?—

Pekhewe'en qa yeku'ƚ pa'aj: —Ha' Cornelio hikha' ewi'ƚ centurión, hakha'an yatsathen qa yijayaanija iye pa' Dios. Week ene' judiol yisu'un hakha'an. Pa' ewi'ƚ ƚaqa ángel pa' Dios yiyaji'ijets pa'aj qu' ne'niihet ei pe'ye', hats'inha qu' amii ke' ƚetsi' ma' qa' nepiye' hakha'an pa'qu' it'ijets.—

Ma' qa ha' Pedro qa yuihinteje'mkii pa'aj pekhewe'en qa mexe yiwhini'. Ma' qa neƚukii pa'aj qa niipha'm qa yijayan pa'aj pekhewe'en. Qa uja'x pe' ƚijts'eyek pekhewe' yijayan pa' Jesús tetseti'yi' pa' Jope.
Pakhap iye neƚukii qa hats uiji'teje'm pa'aj pa' Cesarea. Pa' Cornelio hats notki'ik'ui pa'aj, no'thet wetju'ƚ pe' ƚejefets qa pe' ƚejuwaikalija iye.
Qa ƚunye'jkii pa'aj ha' Pedro in hats yamets pa'aj pa' ƚetset pa' Cornelio, qa pa' Cornelio qa nekiifik'i pa'aj qu' newetfeli'm qa wonokok'entaxifi ƚef'iyeyiiju' pa' Pedro ma' qa iyintaxets.
Qa hakha'ƚe Pedro qa niihinpha'm pa'aj, qa yit'ijets: —Ats'ap'aye', yakha' iye ye'jukhewƚe.—
Qa mexe tafaakate'yi'ƚ pa'aj pakha'an, qa i'nk'aƚe qa uiteje'm qa yeeƚtax pa'aj in olots pe' jukhew qa efuts iye ewi'ƚ i'nik'uyi' pa'aj.

Ma' qa yit'ijji'ju' pa'aj: —Ekheweli'ƚ ƚenikfe'li'ƚetsha ene' judiol in nite' ƚenexkeliji'm qu' qapi'ikii pa'qu' jukhewiika'ye' qa qu' nuyifi iye pe'qu' ƚetsi'ye', qa pakha'ƚe Dios qa ts'ethinij qu' hasu'uj hit'ijets pa'qu' ewii'ƚe' jukhewe' qu' uƚ'axe'.
Qa hik ta'ƚijupi' in heiniyinhei, qa aje'eƚ henek, ham hit'i'ij. Qa hane'ej qa tsikfeliyu'ets, ¿pa'n ƚii pa' ta'ƚijupi' in ƚ'iyini'ƚyii?—

Ma' qa pa' Cornelio qa yeku'ƚ pa'aj, qa yit'ij: —Hats ikwetju'ƚ (4) neƚutsik'i hik i'ni' hane'ej jelji' junu' las tres in k'iyin ene' yitsi'ifi, ma' qa hi'wen ha' ewi'ƚ jukhew ts'ap'ayipji' leppepep he' ƚeqhinatai.
Qa yit'ij yiwets: “Cornelio, aka' iyinheye'j yepi'ye' na' Dios, qa nite' nitapi'ik'i iye in ƚi'fen nekhewe' ham yiwq'axine'.
Qa hik ta'ƚijupi', ukinii pe'ye' ha' witset Jope, qa nenka'x ha' Simón ƚii iye Pedro. Hakha'an i'wi' ke' ƚetsi'ii hakhap iye Simón inqa'metets ƚ'ajits naqsi'jju' metetsju' ha' qi iweli'.”

Qa hik ta'ƚijupi' in aje'eƚ he'nukin ei ne' jukhew, qa qi'ija in ƚe'wisij in ƚenek. Qa hane'ej qa hats ye'weeki'ƚ in ewi'ƚ ha'ni'ƚik'uyi' pa' Dios, hats'inha qu' hepi'ye'eƚ week pakha' nukin ejmet pa' Yatsat'ax'inij.—
Pa' Pedro ma' qa iyetifi pe' Cornelio ƚetsi'.
Ma' qa ha' Pedro qa iyet pa'aj, qa yit'ijji'ju': —Yijaa'ija hane'ej in hats tsikfee'letsha pa' Dios in week ƚeqjunyejeyij ene' jukhew,
qe week yijat'ij pa'qu' witset'e, pakha' qu' ne'nijiweyiju'ƚ qa yaqsiijkii iye pa' yatsathen, pa' Dios qa t'eku'mi'.
Aka' wi'tlijei nukinetsju' pa' Dios enewe' ƚelits pa' Israel'ik'i, qa nifel pa' Dios qu' ƚe'sitsi'iƚ wetju'ƚ ene' jukhew qu' nata'ƚets ha' Jesucristo, hikha' Yatsat'axipji' ene' week.
Ekheweli'ƚ ƚenikfe'li'ƚetsha kakha' ƚunye'jkii ha'ne week sehe' Judea, qa ta'ƚi' in i'nk'a i'nju' hakha' sehe' ei Galilea, in hats ƚ'anu'upji' ka' Juan in wenqimpuujinkii qa nifel iye pa'n ƚunye'j.

Ekheweli'ƚ ƚenikfe'li'ƚets pa'n ƚunye'j pa' Dios in yatsi'yipji' ha' Jesús Nazaret ƚeiƚe' pa' Espíritu Santo qa pa' ƚet'unha'x, hik ha'ne yijalkisijkii in yaqsiijkii pa' ƚe'wis qa niƚinju'kii iye hekhewe' ƚeƚinheitaxij pa' inwo'met, qe pa' Dios i'nijupha hakha'an.
Yekheweli'ƚ hi'weni'ƚij week ekewe' wekwek yaqsiiji'kii ha'ne ƚeqe sehe' ene' judiol qa na' Jerusalenii iye. Qa hi'weni'ƚij iye in yilan qa yenji'pha'm ke' ewi'ƚ k'aayaji' (cruz).
Qa hane'en pa' Dios qa yiƚin iye in yamets wetshetk'ewi'ƚ neƚuts qa yaqsiijkii iye in we'nethinkii,

qa nite' week qu' ne'nethinetskii, qe uja'xƚe yijat'ij hekhewe' hayiits t'eku'miiji'kii pa'aj pa' Dios qu' ni'wen hakha'an, ikji', yekheweli'ƚ in yekufe'eƚijkii hakha'an in hats niyik'uipha'm iye pe' naxju'.
Qa ts'ukini'ƚij qu' henfeli'ƚi'm ene' jukhew qa efuts iye, qa' hit'iƚijets in hik hakha'ija pakha' yeni' pa' Dios qu' juezsi'ipji' pe' iƚii qa pe' naxju' iye.
Hane'en hik ha'ne yit'ijets pa'aj pe' week profetas'ik'i, qu' kakha'ye' ƚii qu' hik kakha'ye' qu' nata'ƚets qa' weeke' pakha' qu' nite' neqeku'ye' hakha'an qa' netwumhiti'yik'ui pe' ƚewuƚ'ets.—
Mexe nite' yili'ij pa'aj ha' Pedro in nifel ekewe'en, pa' Espíritu Santo qa namju' pa'aj qa i'nipji' pekhewe' weekji' tek'enets pa'aj ekewe' tefelhitii.
Week pa'aj pekhewe' judiol nite' yeqeku' pa' Jesús, hik pekhewe' ƚijts'eyek pa'aj ha' Pedro, qa yitjuƚaxijpha'mkii pa'aj, qe pakha' witqisit Espíritu Santo testi'yij iye pekhewe' nite' judioltax,
qe yepi'ye' in iyetju' qa tujtseikal pe' ƚe'lijei qa qi iye in yiwqinhetji' pa' Dios. Ma' qa ha' Pedro qa yit'ij pa'aj:
—¿Me ƚeke' qu' nana'l pakha' qu' nite' niwejini'im enewe'en qu' nempulijijju' in hats testi'yij pa' Espíritu Santo in injunyejeyek?—
Ma' qa inaqyaji'ij qu' netenimpulijinijju' aka' ƚiiji' pa' Jesucristo. Pekhewe'en qa mexe iyinijets iye pa'aj ha' Pedro qu' mexe amane' eku'nijup iye pe'qu' uja'xe' neƚutse'.

footnotes.text: Centurión ikji' tenek'enhe'yipji' ek pa'aj pe'qu' cien (100) oq'opheƚinetsiletse'.
